title.narrative: Karnataka Integrated and Sustainable Water Resources Management Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The investment program will improve water availability in selected river basins in Karnataka by implementing integrated water resources management (IWRM). Output 1 of Project 2 will: (i) prepare the middle Krishna Basin Plan; (ii) expand the state water resources information system; and (iii) continue strengthening WRD staff with IWRM training. Output 2 will modernize the Vijayanagara Channels subproject to: (i) reduce irrigation water consumption; and (ii) improve water delivery service to allow farmers to increase cropping intensities. Under Output 2, the project will also establish and strengthen 30 water user cooperative societies and provide gender sensitization training to WRD staff and WUCS.

description.narrative: IWRM successfully implemented in selected river basins in Karnataka

29 VNC WUCS confirmed receipt of improved water delivery service Progress/Status: All 29 VNC WUCS have been established, and the receipt of improved water delivery service has been confirmed. Data Source: KNNL and/or CADA annual and scheme monitoring reports Base year: 2019 Baseline value: N

River basin plan for the Middle Krishna Basin (K2, K3, K4 sub-basins) endorsed by Executive Committee of ACIWRM (2019 baseline: n.a.) Progress/Status: The river basin (RB) modeling was completed for 3 sub-basins. The RB Profile and Atlas were completed for the K4 sub-basin. The RB Plan for K4 is under review, and K2 is under preparation. The implementation roadmap for water policy was prepared and approved. Data Source: WRD and/or ACIWRM annual reports and scheme monitoring reports Base year: 2019 Baseline value: N

VNC tertiary irrigation system operated and maintained by the VNC WUCS Progress/Status: Of the 29 WUCS under VNC, all 29 are registered and have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Executive Engineer, KNNL, for the operation and maintenance of the tertiary irrigation system. Data Source: KNNL and/or CADA annual and scheme monitoring reports Base year: 2019 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: VNC irrigation system infrastructure and management modernized Indicator: 11 anicuts, intake structures, and 414 km of irrigation canals covering 11,150 ha upgraded Progress/Status: Tranche 2 objective is to upgrade 414 km of canals into two packages.
VNC Package-1 (excluding works in Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve and Hampi World Heritage Area): As of 24 September 2024, 163 km of lining work completed (83%) out of 196.62 km; 1,103 out of 1,089 structures (101%); 1.34 km (61%) out of 2.202 km length of anicut is completed; 22.25 km (51%) out of 43.26 km length of distributaries is completed and only 1.42 km against 152.08 km length of minors is completed.
VNC Package-2: Under this package 8 anicuts are envisaged to be upgraded in the Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve and Turtha Canal 18.69 km, covering a total CCA of 931 ha in the Hampi World Heritage Area, including 168 structures along the canal. The contract agreement has been signed on 2 March 2023 for 24 months. As of 24 September 2024, anicuts of length 5.91 km (77%) completed against the revised length of 7.68 km; Turtha canal lining of 7.58 km (54%) out of the revised length of 13.98 km (8 no.'s) is completed, and 46 (35%) structures out of 130 are completed.
VNC-CPP: Command Area Development (CAD) works package: As of 24 September 2024, 551 packages were awarded out of the target 598 packages (529 field irrigation channels (FICs) and 22 WUCS buildings), and the remaining 47 packages were dropped out. About 446 km (87%) of FICs out of about 513 km and 15 WUCS Buildings are completed.
Spillover works beyond the loan closure date would be completed by July 2025 using state its own funds. Data Source: KNNL annual reports and scheme monitoring reports Actual value:

Output: VNC irrigation system infrastructure and management modernized Indicator: 29 WUCS established and trained on operation and maintenance of tertiary irrigation system and improved on-farm water application methods (with 30% women representation in management boards and 40% attendance in training) Progress/Status: As of 24 September 2024, all 29 WUCS are established. MOUs with KNNL have been signed for irrigation water management, water charges collection, and O&M responsibilities (this is considered “established”).
The total farmers covered among 29 WUCS are 14,855 of which 10,501 (70.7%) are male and 4,354 (29.3%) are female.
All 29 WUCS signed an MOU with KNNL for the operation and maintenance of the tertiary irrigation system. Under the Sustainable Agriculture Program, exclusive training with Farmers Field Schools, Demonstrations, and other training on improved on-farm water application methods is being carried out.
Women are represented on the management boards of the established 29 WUCS 110 (32%). Per the statutory provisions, the total number of office bearers among 29 WUCS is 348, of which 344 positions are filled.
Women sub-committees: 60 women sub-committees formed with 959 members.
Overall Capacity Building activity: As part of capacity-building programs, 1,445 events, covering 37,972 participants, of which 25,739 are men (68%) and 12,233 are women (32%), have been completed. Data Source: KNNL and CADA annual reports with sex-disaggregated data Actual value:

Output: VNC irrigation system infrastructure and management modernized Indicator: At least 50% of KNNL staff in the Irrigation Central Zone office, Munirabad (80% of total female staff) reported increased knowledge on the application of gender concepts and principles to water resource management. As of 24 September 2024, five workshops on GESI concepts, mainstreaming women, and water resource management principles were held for KNNL staff.
A total of 134 staff (67% of filled staff) have been trained of which 98 were men and 36 were women. (Total: 134; M: 98; F: 36) Data Source: Pre- and post-training assessment Actual value:
